name: diagrams
description: Pins the diagrams Claude draws to a chip above the prompt: expand it in place, open it full screen or in the browser, and see it as a rendered picture

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: terminal follows your terminal's own colors; the presets paint a fixed palette whatever Claude Code's theme is

pictures.title: Pictures
pictures.description: on: Claude adds a Mermaid version of each diagram and the mod renders it as a picture where the terminal shows images (Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm), using mmdc or the pinned @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli through npx

fullScreenPalette.title: Full screen palette
fullScreenPalette.description: same uses the Palette above; a preset paints only the full-screen pane, the card keeping its own colors
